card.name: Dollar sign in code and shell prompts
card.fires_on: The dollar sign starting a Perl variable or a shell prompt in code or manual text. It also fires weakly on SQL type words like varchar after a column name.

modes.label: Dollar sign in code
modes.description: A $ that begins a Perl variable or a shell command prompt.

modes.label: SQL column types
modes.description: The type word varchar after a quoted column name in a CREATE TABLE statement.

card.plain: It reacts to programming text, mostly the $ symbol in Perl code or command-line examples, and sometimes SQL column types.
